title: The Cloud Dream of the Nine (Kuunmong)
summary: The Cloud Dream of the Nine (Kuunmong) is a romance by the yangban official Kim Man-jung (1637-1692), written in seventeenth-century Korea. A young Buddhist monk dreams he is reborn and marries eight women in succession, in a story set in Tang China. The Literature Translation Institute of Korea lists its year as 1687.

uncertainty.note: Only the Literature Translation Institute of Korea gives a year (1687, in its 'Published Year' field); Penguin says only 'written in 17th-century Korea'. Other sources not opened give c. 1689, so the date is held loosely.

where.modern_name: Korean Peninsula (region centre; labelled proxy pin, place of writing not stated)

importance.justification: A leading Korean classic, described by its Penguin edition as Korea's most prized literary masterpiece (Penguin Classics).
